verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents its own self-hosted deployment option, aimed explicitly at data residency, that keeps all customer data (experiment logs, traces, datasets, prompts) within your own cloud account and region, while Braintrust still provides the managed UI and auth. Choosing a region therefore means deploying and operating your own data-plane infrastructure; the evidence shows no region choice within the managed SaaS. missing for 10: managed-cloud region selection (e.g. US/EU hosted regions), documentation of supported regions or clouds for self-hosting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
